'''Starting Forces''' details the Day 1 military reset applied to all parties across Calradia in ''Realms of Dust''.  == The Military Reset == To eliminate preexisting faction dominance and enforce balanced competition, all existing field armies, veteran rosters, and captured prisoners are wiped at campaign initialization.  == Day 1 Party Compositions == Every field commander?including the player character and all AI realm rulers?enters the campaign map with an identical retinue: * '''Party Commander:''' The noble lord or player character on horseback. * '''Escort Retinue:''' Exactly '''8 Tier-1 Recruits''' drawn from the ruler's native culture (e.g., Imperial Recruits, Vlandian Recruits, Battanian Volunteers). * '''Prisoners:''' 0 starting prisoners.  == Operational Impact == * '''Bandit Deterrence:''' An 8-man escort provides sufficient defensive mass to deter stray low-level looters during the initial recruitment phase. * '''Field Speed:''' Because starting parties carry only 9 total riders/footmen, field movement speed is high (typically 5.5+ speed), enabling rapid transit between bound villages. * '''Recruitment Progression:''' Armies must be built and trained from scratch by recruiting from bound villages, defeating outlaw bands, and investing training time.
